blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Government forces are pursuing a still unidentified armed group harassing residents in the town of Talitay, Maguindanao del Norte. Lt. Col. Leonard Jack B. Orbase, commanding officer of the Army’s 1st Mechanized Infantry Battalion, said soldiers had a brief encounter with an undetermined number of members of the group on Thursday. READ: Most wanted Dawlah Islamiyah member slain in Maguindanao del Sur Orbase said the soldiers were responding to reports from civilians about alleged gunfire by an armed group in the town, which had caused fear and anxiety among residents.
